reasons.chart: The chart “{{name}}” is shown as its picture.
reasons.chartSkipped: The chart “{{name}}” was left out: the file has no picture of it.
reasons.ole: The embedded object “{{name}}” is shown as its preview picture.
reasons.oleSkipped: The embedded object “{{name}}” was left out: its preview cannot be shown.
reasons.smartart: The SmartArt “{{name}}” is shown as a picture.
reasons.smartartSkipped: The SmartArt “{{name}}” was left out: the file has no drawing of it.
reasons.table: The table “{{name}}” became a text box with its rows.
reasons.unsupportedPicture: The picture “{{name}}” was left out: EMF, WMF and TIFF pictures cannot be shown.
reasons.unsupportedPictureBackground: The background picture was left out: EMF, WMF and TIFF pictures cannot be shown.
reasons.convertVideo: The video “{{name}}” shows only its first picture: convert it to MP4 and add it again.
reasons.unsupportedMedia: The video or sound “{{name}}” was left out: its format cannot be played.
reasons.linkedMedia: “{{name}}” was left out: it links to a file outside the presentation.
reasons.linkedMediaBackground: The background picture was left out: it links to a file outside the presentation.
reasons.playOnClick: A video PowerPoint starts on a click plays as soon as the slide shows; its click is kept.
reasons.audio: The sound “{{name}}” plays without its icon.
reasons.transition: The “{{name}}” transition plays as a fade.
reasons.animation_one: {{count}} animation effect plays as a fade or a pulse.
reasons.animation_other: {{count}} animation effects play as a fade or a pulse.
reasons.motionPath_one: {{count}} motion path keeps its click but does not move.
reasons.motionPath_other: {{count}} motion paths keep their click but do not move.
reasons.interactive_one: {{count}} animation started by clicking a shape was left out.
reasons.interactive_other: {{count}} animations started by clicking a shape were left out.
reasons.shape: The shape “{{name}}” is drawn as a rectangle.
reasons.gradient: The gradient of “{{name}}” is drawn in its first colour.
reasons.gradientBackground: The background's gradient is drawn in its first colour.
reasons.embeddedFonts: The fonts embedded in the file are not used yet: the text shows in the closest font the app has.
reasons.mediaTooLarge: “{{name}}” was left out: it is larger than the Gallery allows.
reasons.uploadFailed: “{{name}}” could not be uploaded to the Gallery.
reasons.hiddenSlide: A hidden slide, left out as in a slide show.

midi.playFromHere: Play from just before this verse and tap again from it
